applicant_utility.summary: Charpak pays a flat EUR 860 monthly living allowance, so treat it as a top-up to your own funding rather than a full ride - it is aimed at living costs, not tuition. It only works if you already hold, or are in the process of obtaining, admission to a full-time degree programme in France, because that admission comes first in the process. The interview window is fixed and non-negotiable, and the current 2026 round is closed, so watch the Campus France India page for the next opening.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Indian citizens or OCI holders aged 23 or younger (Bachelor) or 30 or younger (Master) admitted to a full-time French degree who need help with living costs rather than tuition.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure your French admission letter first; if it is still pending, collect the email correspondence proving you are in the process, as this is explicitly accepted.
Check your age against the application date, not the course start date: 23 or younger for the Bachelor track, 30 or younger for Master.
Write the statement of purpose yourself - the committee runs a plagiarism check and disqualifies significant AI-generated content.
Keep the interview window free (recent rounds ran April); the embassy will not reschedule interviews.
Convert every upload to PDF or JPEG before the deadline.
common_rejection_risks: Submitting more than one online application - an automatic disqualification, so list your top choice instead of duplicating applications.
Uploading Word, RTF, ODT, TXT or MSG files, zip folders, screenshots or social-media scans - only PDF and JPEG are accepted and incorrect formats are rejected.
A recommendation letter that is unsigned or missing the referee's contact details, or not on institutional headed paper.
Significant AI-generated content in the statement of purpose, flagged by the plagiarism check.
Taking a gap year, an apprenticeship contract or an exchange after the award, or holding another French government, Erasmus or AUF scholarship - all trigger revocation.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Travel to and within France, tuition fees (only a conditional exemption from differentiated fees at public institutions for national-diploma programmes is published, and it must be verified with your own institution), the CVEC, and any stay expenses beyond the allowance.
document_audit: Only PDF and JPEG are accepted; the pages explicitly reject Word, RTF, ODT, TXT, MSG, zip folders, screenshots and social-media scans.
Passport: upload the first page showing photo and expiry date, and attach proof of your passport application if the passport is not yet issued.
Marksheets must include completed semesters of the ongoing degree, not only finished qualifications.
Recommendation letters must be scanned copies of original typed and signed paper letters, preferably on headed institutional paper with a stamp, and referencing the scholarship.
alerts: The interview window (April in recent rounds) is fixed and will not be rescheduled for individual candidates.

The award can be revoked if you hold another French government, Erasmus or AUF scholarship, sign an apprenticeship or professional training contract, take a gap year or exchange, or are refused a visa.
If any semester of your programme takes place outside France, the scholarship will not cover that period.
The current 2026 round is closed on the official pages and no next-round dates are published yet - do not rely on third-party deadline listings.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One application on the Institut francais India scholarship portal, then committee screening of complete files, an online interview for shortlisted candidates, and results communicated by email; incomplete applications receive no response.

official.description: Since 2018 the Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) initiative has been a flagship programme for postdoctoral mobility in France and one of the leading fellowship programmes of the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. The 2027 call, funded by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs in partnership with the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Space and implemented by Campus France, enables young international researchers to carry out a research project in France and grants them the status of French Government Scholarship holders (BGF).

applicant_utility.summary: MOPGA funds a full twelve-month postdoctoral research stay in France with a EUR 2,500 monthly allowance, a EUR 500 settling-in grant and French health coverage, but nothing else - you pay for your own flights and the host laboratory covers its own costs. The 2027 call opened on 15 September 2026 and closes on 15 December 2026 for stays starting between September and December 2027, so that mid-December portal deadline is the only date that matters. Your project has to sit squarely inside one of the five environmental research themes and be carried by a French host laboratory that formally commits to hosting you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-French researchers who defended their PhD between December 2021 and December 2026 and work on climate, energy, earth-system or One Health topics with a French laboratory already willing to host them.
application_readiness_checklist: Line up the host laboratory first: you need a supervisor support letter co-signed by the laboratory director, or the director's separate commitment letter, before you can submit.
Confirm your thesis defence date falls between December 2021 and December 2026 inclusive; if the diploma is not yet issued, obtain official proof of defence now.
Draft the project against the published character limits - 2,000 characters for most sections and 4,500 for methodology and timeline.
Trim your CV to four pages including the publication list, and request your supervisor's CV early so it fits within two pages.
Submit in English or French through the SMApply portal well before 15 December 2026, as email submissions are not considered.
common_rejection_risks: A project that drifts outside the five research themes, or a One Health proposal without a genuine animal or ecosystem dimension - pure human-health projects are explicitly ineligible.
A support letter that is not co-signed by the laboratory director and lacks the director's separate commitment letter.
A PhD defended outside the December 2021 to December 2026 window.
Trying to stack MOPGA on top of a French employment contract or another French government grant, which the rules prohibit.
Missing the 15 December 2026 portal deadline - late or emailed applications are not reviewed.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International travel to France, any laboratory or research costs (host laboratories receive no programme funding), and living costs beyond what the monthly allowance and settling-in grant cover.
document_audit: The supervisor letter must be co-signed by the laboratory director or accompanied by the director's commitment letter; a supervisor letter alone leaves the file incomplete.
If the PhD certificate has not been issued, submit an official certificate confirming the defence, proof of thesis submission, or another official institutional document.
The supervisor's CV is part of the file and capped at two pages, so request it before you start writing the project.
Each project section has a hard character limit including spaces, from the 2,000-character summary to the 4,500-character methodology and timeline.
alerts: French nationals are excluded, and you must not be residing and professionally active in France when you apply.
The fellowship cannot be combined with a French employment contract or any other individual funding awarded by a French government entity.
The five-year PhD window can be extended for maternity leave (18 months per child or the actual leave duration) only if supporting documents are uploaded with the application.
Results arrive May-June 2027 and the stay must begin between September and December 2027, so plan visa and laboratory logistics around that window.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online submission via the Campus France SMApply portal, review by ministry-appointed scientific experts, final selection by a scientific committee, results by email in May-June 2027, then a 12-month research stay starting between September and December 2027.
